purpose: Teach: 祖先/生前/独断/戦死/胎児/判別/二酸化炭素/裁定

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、祖先からの教えを大切にしろ
lines.en: Our company values the teachings passed down from our founders.
lines.style: Measured, authoritative opening. Steady pace with slight weight on 「大切に」. Formal register—this is principle being stated, not debated. Clear eye contact, composed posture.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。創業者の生前の理念を新人にも伝えます
lines.en: Understood. I'll make sure to share the founder's vision with all new staff.
lines.style: Respectful, attentive nod in the voice. Even cadence, slightly faster than the boss to show readiness. Professional but not stiff—genuine commitment underneath the formality.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 独断的な経営判断は避けろ
lines.en: Avoid making decisions based on personal judgment alone.
lines.style: Direct and firm. Light emphasis on the negation. No softening—this is a clear directive. Steady breathing, measured delivery. The tone of someone who has learned this the hard way.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。先代戦死者の慰霊祭にも参加いたします
lines.en: Yes. We'll also make sure to participate in the memorial service for those who came before us.
lines.style: Calm confirmation. Slight reverence in the tone when touching on the memorial aspect—he understands the weight of what's being referenced. Steady, reliable delivery.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、胎児向け商品の安全性を最優先しろ
lines.en: Make product safety for expectant mothers and infants your top priority.
lines.style: Slowed pace slightly. Firm but not harsh—this is about care, not just compliance. Slight emphasis on 「最優先」. Clear, direct instruction from someone who holds this standard.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。色の判別がしやすい商品設計を進めております
lines.en: Understood. We're already improving our product design to make color differentiation easier for visibility and safety.
lines.style: Detailed, professional response showing preparation. Steady pace. Confidence without arrogance—he's reporting on concrete progress. Attentive to the boss's standards.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、二酸化炭素削減の取り組みを進めろ
lines.en: Move forward with our company's carbon reduction initiatives.
lines.style: Forward-looking, resolute. Even pacing with a slight push on the verb. This is about environmental responsibility—delivered with conviction, not as busy-work. Composed authority.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。裁定機関への対応も準備しております
lines.en: Yes. We're also preparing to coordinate with the relevant regulatory bodies.
lines.style: Final confirmation with closure. Slightly quicker tempo showing completion of the list. Professional and prepared. A note of quiet competence—the final piece is handled.
